id.description: Module id. Equals the module folder name and the manifest name, unique forever.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository with readable source, exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>: no .git, no further path, query, fragment, user or port. Required for community and verified tiers.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit of repo that this listing is for: the listing check runs on it and the Source link points to it. Required with repo; an update is a new commit.

version.description: The release Celerp distributes. Official and verified tiers only; a community module's version is the one in its own manifest.

data_access.description: What data the module touches. Required for community and verified tiers: an author self-declaration for community, cross-checked against the manifest for verified.

network_calls.description: Any network calls the module makes. Same declaration rules as data_access.

feedback.description: Where to share experiences: the module's Discussion in this repo.

sha256.description: sha256 of the vault snapshot built from commit. Verified tier only.
